name: Gamophobia
source:
No matter what you do. No matter how hard you try. There is only one ending waiting for you.

Gamophobia’s alternate-reality Toronto is the setting in which you will woo and date the physical manifestations of common phobias. In this doomed visual novel, live and learn through the vignettes of fourteen vastly different yet ultimately similar relationships. The Fears grow less scary as you get to know them: Unpack why people are afraid of them by learning their histories and what exactly makes them tick. 

Will you still fear them by the end of it?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5046730/Gamophobia/]Steam[/url]]
